audience: small service businesses who manage customers, leads and invoices in Method CRM

useCases.title: Find customers and leads by name, email or type
useCases.text: The AI searches customers and leads by text in the name or email, or by lead or customer type, and returns name, email, phone, lead flag and status.

useCases.title: List unpaid invoices with the customer's email
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with a balance remaining, optionally older than a date, with customer, amount and balance. It can total the outstanding amount for you.

useCases.title: Read the calls, emails and notes on a customer
useCases.text: The AI lists activities for a customer or lead, such as calls, emails, to-dos and notes, newest first, with the note text.

useCases.title: Run a custom query or count on any table
useCases.text: The AI lists your tables and fields, then queries or counts records with filters and sums, for example totals per customer.

useCases.title: Create a lead or customer and log a call note
useCases.text: The AI creates a lead or customer, after a search to avoid duplicates, and logs an activity such as a call note on it.

useCases.title: Create or update a record in any table
useCases.text: The AI creates a record such as an estimate or item, or changes fields on one record. Changes to accounting records sync to QuickBooks or Xero.
